title: Expansion of the Degree-One Fourier Weight
statement: For any real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the sum of its squared Fourier coefficients over subsets of size at most one equals the square of its coefficient at the empty subset plus the sum, over all coordinates, of the squared coefficients at the corresponding singleton subsets.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
